title: Production Issues & Root Cause Analysis
subtitle: Incident Response & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Studio
description: A production issue occurs in the Attendance Sync microservice. Twelve branch officers experience intermittent 504 Gateway Timeouts. Restore the service, verify affected branch officers, document the Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and prioritise preventive controls.

stakeholders.name: Martha
stakeholders.agenda: Urgent restoration of branch check-in capabilities for 12 locked-out branch officers.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Brooks
stakeholders.agenda: Diagnosing memory leak in container connection pool and deploying hotfix.

stakeholders.name: Aarav
stakeholders.agenda: Enforcing post-mortem governance: RCA, verification before closure, and preventive monitoring.

objectives.label: Arrange immediate service restoration sequence & verify branch officers
Build formal 4-part Root Cause Analysis connecting failure to root cause
Select and prioritise preventive measures to eliminate recurrence
